assistant-first-orphan.note: Intentional. History opens with an assistant tool_use that trimLeadingAssistantHistory removes, leaving its tool_result answering a call that is no longer in the payload. Before the refactor sanitizeKiroHistory narrated that stale result into the user turn (content=20); now stripOrphanedToolResults removes it first, so the turn is empty and takes the minimal fallback (content=1). The alternate account path emits nothing for an empty user turn (external_openai.go:418), so no empty role:user reaches an upstream.
